description: Jon Wullenweber deposits one year of SafeCREW CS#1H of field monitoring at an infiltration ditch and an abstraction well in a managed aquifer recharge system. Zenodo lists a public XLSX measurement table, a short README, and two archives of chromatography and optical scans under CC BY 4.0. The README identifies sample date and point, UV absorbance, dissolved and total organic carbon, LC-OCD fractions, and flow-cytometry cell counts. It also names dilution and chromatogram reference fields. These observations could help calibrate or check a model of microbial transport and natural-organic-matter removal during subsurface drinking-water treatment. The site country and exact monitoring dates are not stated in the public description and are left unspecified here. The README calls the main table a CSV and says its second row contains units, but the public file inventory lists an XLSX. The measurement files and archives were not downloaded, so column contents and units remain unverified. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this two-point SafeCREW aquifer-recharge monitoring dataset.
name: CS#1H Monitoring Data of Subsurface Passage in Managed Aquifer Recharge: Microbial and Organic Composition Analysis
